caption.instagram:
The free weekend you're waiting for is never coming.

Maya had 8 weeks until her sister's wedding and wanted to give her a portrait she drew herself. Three weekends went to a birthday and chores. Paper still blank.

So she changed the plan:
1. 20 minutes every morning, before work (the 20 minutes she used to scroll in bed)
2. One skill a week: shapes, proportions, eyes, shading, the portrait
3. When week 4 came out muddy, she didn't quit. Same 20 minutes, next morning.

35 mornings. About 12 hours of drawing. One framed portrait.

Send this to someone who's still waiting for a free weekend.
